pathAssistantSteps.info:
• Capture the cancellation reason in the work order record.
  • Notify recruiter, client, and candidate.
  • Archive or close related tasks to avoid open activities.
  • Mark record clearly for reporting purposes.

• Mark this stage once work is fully completed.
  • Ensure timesheets, invoices, and client sign-off are recorded.
  • All related extended work orders will be auto-updated to Completed.
  • Finalize End Date and ensure it matches actual completion.
  • Begin release process by preparing exit checklist.

• Use the Extend Work Order quick action to create a new work order.
  • Capture reason for extension in the work order notes.
  • Update expected end date and notify finance/project team.
  • Update End Date to reflect new work order duration.
  • Current work order will automatically move to Extended.

• Collect required documents (ID proofs, contracts, agreements).
  • Ensure background checks and compliance checks are initiated.
  • Update joining date, reporting manager, and location fields.
  • Set Start Date once joining date is confirmed.
  • Once onboarding tasks are completed, update the status to Working.

• Assign the candidate to this stage after interview qualification.
  • Verify candidate’s job position, role, and joining date fields.
  • Keep the candidate informed about the onboarding process and next steps.
  • Notify project manager and recruiter team.

• Specify the reason in the On Hold Reason field.
  • Communicate with both candidate and client regarding the pause.
  • Set a tentative resume date if available.
  • Resume the process as soon as the issue is resolved.

• Ensure all No Dues (finance, assets, client confirmation) are cleared.
  • Update release/exit date in the system.
  • Notify HR and client about candidate release.
  • Finalize release formalities (handover, clearance docs).

• Confirm all onboarding formalities are complete.
  • Ensure time tracking or attendance system is set up.
  • Keep regular updates on performance in notes or related records.
  • Set End Date for current work order.
  • Candidate remains in this stage until work order expires.
